description: Sends a notice from the organizer of an event, or a host of a personal event, to the people who added the event pass to their phone's Wallet ("doors open at 7 now", "the keynote moved to Hall B", "Sonar meetup at The Bar on 2nd at 8 PM"). Needs a personal connector token, `eventIdOrName`, `audience` and `text`. Each pass holder in the chosen group sees the line on their lock screen (Apple Wallet shows it as the pass's own change notice; Google Wallet shows it as a Wallet notification) and the line stays on the pass. `audience` names the group: everyone, one ticket tier, one badge intent, an explicit list of pass serials, the people who scanned at a booth, or the people who answered an earlier meetup notice yes or no. A meetup is a notice with a place: `placeLabel`, with `latitude` and `longitude` when known, makes the pass surface again on the lock screen near that place reading "Sonar meetup inside, show this pass."; `at` gives the hour. It works in two steps: a call without `confirm` returns a preview with the number of passes in the group and the exact lock-screen line for the organizer to approve, and sends nothing; a call with confirm true sends. Only the hosts or the organizer of the event can send; anybody else is refused. The vendor audience "my_booth" is switched off by ruling and returns VENDOR_OFF. Six notices an hour per event; a seventh returns RATE_LIMITED. It reaches pass holders only; it does not tell anybody who else is there, and it does not report that a person arrived.

at.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the hour, as a full timestamp with a time zone ("2027-06-12T20:00:00-07:00").

audience.description: Who the notice is for. "everyone" is every pass of the event; "tier" one ticket tier (with `tier`); "intent" one badge intent (with `intent`); "serials" an explicit list (with `serials`); "booth" the people who scanned at a booth the organizer names (with `boothId`); "meetup_yes" or "meetup_no" the people who answered an earlier meetup notice (with its `noticeId`). "my_booth" is a vendor sending to their own leads; it is switched off by ruling and returns VENDOR_OFF.

boothId.description: For audience "booth" or "my_booth": the booth id.

confirm.description: Absent for a preview: the reply gives the number of passes in the group and the exact lock-screen line, and nothing is sent. true sends the notice.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as the organizer or the hosts spell it.

intent.description: For audience "intent": Buyer, Vendor, Networker or Social.

latitude.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the place's latitude. Both coordinates or neither.

longitude.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the place's longitude. Both coordinates or neither.

noticeId.description: For audience "meetup_yes" or "meetup_no": the noticeId an earlier meetup notice answered with.

placeLabel.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the name of the place ("The Bar on 2nd"). With `latitude` and `longitude` the pass surfaces on the lock screen when the person is near it.

relevantText.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup with coordinates: the line the lock screen shows NEAR the place. Default: "Sonar meetup inside, show this pass."

requestId.description: Optional. An id for this notice chosen by the caller; one id sends once.

serials.description: For audience "serials": the pass serial numbers, at most fifty.

text.description: REQUIRED. The notice, one plain line of up to 120 characters, in the organizer's words. This exact line is what the lock screen shows. No links, no markup.

tier.description: For audience "tier": general, vendor or host.

name: event_pass_notice
title: Send a notice to a group of pass holders (hosts and organizers only)
